name: Fuzzy search when choosing a data root
description: ## Summary: Let people type to fuzzy-find a Data Root wherever they choose one, instead of scrolling a long list (the attachment shows the startup picker with 25 known Data Roots). ## Current behavior: (1) The startup picker "Choose a Data Root" (src/tui/screens/setup/DataRootPickerScreen.tsx, route data-roots from src/tui/onboardingRoute.ts) uses SelectList, whose "/" filter only does a case-insensitive substring match on the row label (label or path plus the default/missing suffix) and ignores the path when a label is set. (2) The Data Root switcher modal (src/tui/shell/DataRootSwitcher.tsx, opened with D or the header button) has no search at all. ## Scope: Add type-to-search to both. Reuse fuzzySearch from src/core/fuzzySearch.ts, which is already used by SearchableSelectPicker and storySearch. Put the matching in one shared helper (for example src/tui/shell/dataRootSearch.ts), not two copies. Search fields for each known Data Root: its name (dataRootName: label, Global or folder), its full path and its tilde path. Ties keep the current order (default first, then registered order; keep ROW-82 ordering if it lands first). ## Interaction: (a) A search line sits above the list, styled like the StoryFinder and SearchableSelectPicker field (theme.fieldFocus, placeholder "Type to search…"). (b) Typing any printable character that is not an action key of that screen starts the search with that character. "/" also focuses it. n (new Data Root), and in the switcher e (edit) and d (delete), keep their meaning while the search is not focused (the AGENTS.md rule that n creates). (c) While the search is focused, every printable key is text. Up/down move the highlight, enter opens the highlighted row, and esc clears the query and leaves the search (in the switcher, esc with an empty, unfocused search closes the modal as now). (d) Each change to the query moves the highlight to the best match. (e) The + New Data Root row stays visible and reachable whatever the query is. With no matches, show "No matching Data Roots." above it. (f) Key hints name the search (for example "type search"), and the position counter counts the matching rows. ## Acceptance: On the startup picker and in the switcher, typing "crew" highlights Crewsum (matched by label) and typing "row-14" highlights the row-14-story-linking worktree root (matched by path). A subsequence such as "rwtst" finds "Rowbly Test". enter opens the highlighted match. esc restores the full list. n still opens New Data Root setup when the search is not focused. Opening, missing-root handling and unsaved-changes confirmation behave as today. ## Out of scope: List order changes and the missing-root modal (ROW-82), mouse-wheel scrolling (ROW-83), moving + New Data Root to the top (ROW-85). ## Docs: docs/user-guide.md (the startup picker paragraph near line 63, the switcher paragraph near line 180, and the D row in the key table near line 1097), skills/rowbly/references/tui.md, and skills/rowbly/references/setup.md if it describes the picker keys. ## Tests: None required (AGENTS.md: keys, screens and filters add no test). Verify with pnpm dev in a folder without .rowbly and with the D switcher, plus an agentic-tui screenshot for the PR. ## Overlaps: ROW-82, ROW-83 and ROW-85 change the same two files. Sequence them; when one lands first, merge origin/main into this branch and resolve conflicts (no rebase or force push).
